svg.title: Maknae workspace package diagram
svg.desc: UML package diagram of the Maknae workspace, layered by dependency.
svg.text: Every package in the workspace, layered by what it depends on. Grey text inside a package is its DIRECT external crates.
Normal dependencies only — dev- and build-dependencies are excluded, since they reach no shipped artifact. An edge is a DECLARED dependency: a manifest entry with no use site still draws one.
The dependency closure of a «trusted» package covers 16 of the 22 workspace packages and 18 of the 23 direct external crates — 14 through maknae-vault alone.
Closure is not TCB membership (see the component view) — but it is the code a privileged package can reach, so it is the surface that matters.
source: cargo metadata (normal deps) · inputs at 5184898 · 2026-09-19
